I noticed your restaurant & banquet hall has strong 4.5★ reviews near AIIMS Golambar in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and party bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, banquet inquiry form, aur special menu showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/retro

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Retro restaurant & Banquet hall team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp booking button and banquet inquiry feature for your location near AIIMS Golambar in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
